checks.equipment: Loop band above both knees, follows garment cross section
checks.setup: 무릎 바로 위에 루프 밴드를 걸고 옆으로 눕는다. 아래쪽 팔로 머리를 받치고 두 무릎을 굽혀 발을 포갠다.
checks.hands: Lower arm supports head, upper hand monitors hip
checks.feet: Both feet and toes fixed with stacked-foot spacing
checks.movement: 골반을 뒤로 돌리지 않고 발을 붙인 채 위쪽 무릎을 천천히 연다. 엉덩이 옆쪽에 힘을 느끼며 무릎을 조절해서 닫는다.

limitations: Procedural demonstration, not captured human motion.
Upper hand placed at hip rather than on floor as in source.
Band path follows sampled garment/body outline with a small visual offset; no elastic-force simulation.
Sampled vertex clearances are not exhaustive collision certification.
